title: AI Harness
logline: Software patterns, applied to AI workflows

tree: Deterministic Python tools the agent runs
Immutable world: frozen sessions, canned API payloads, dummy repo. 1 fixture : N scenarios
YAML specs: happy_path, edge_cases, adversarial. Many scenarios reuse one fixture
Agent harness: run_evals.py (game master), eval_judges.py (tiered grader)
Git-ignored output: history.jsonl ledger, failures/ only on a fail

pts: Fork the frozen agent session per scenario
Sets how the test starts and who the user is
Per-scenario caps on simulation turns and tokens
Safety gate blocks hallucinated or forbidden tools
Tier 1: schema checks (tool request, agent response)
Tier 2: state invariants (tool sequence, file diffs, DB changes)
Tier 3: rubric-based LLM judge, templated response

rows: The real control
Skills call the platform with scoped auth tokens (bot or user's)
Minimal prod changes
Agents run approved write skills, like an allowlist change. Code and table changes go through MRs and tickets
Incidents
Nightly MR from the day's oncall and alarm incidents
Code changes
Weekly batch diffs the registered service repos and opens an MR for new wiki gaps
Engineers
Engineers rate each agent reply at ticket close. Wrong answers fix the wiki and become eval cases
Gated
Evals and Wiki CI run before review. A code owner merges. The agent never does

parts.s: Three levels, like a test pyramid

tiers: Does the full system solve real tickets?
Can an agent find the right doc?
pyramid.loop: Each bad real run becomes a regression case at the lowest level that can catch it

rows: Adoption
~100 weekly active engineers on the Spec Workflow since October, up from 20+
Oncall
~300 tickets condensed into 15 recurring issue classes. Ticket close time improved by 36%
Gate, don't automate
Human-gated write-back worked better than full automation. One human yes per MR keeps the wiki trusted
Test on real traces
Static tests don't prove model behaviour, so bad runs from real traces became the regression set
Frontend
Automated browser-based testing. Frontend support for the Spec Workflow
LangGraph
Move our hand-built orchestration onto LangGraph. Checkpoints, resume and approval interrupts come built in, so we maintain less code
Auto‑triage
Automate Oncall Agent replies, no @ needed, so every ticket gets a reply to rate
